description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for TI HDC temperature and humidity sensors, including initialization, sample fetching, and GPIO callback handling.

methods.name: ti_hdc_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback to disable GPIO and signal data readiness.

methods.name: ti_hdc_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches temperature and humidity samples from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: ti_hdc_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sample data into sensor values for temperature or humidity.

methods.name: read16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register value from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: ti_hdc_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks device ID, and sets up GPIO if needed.
